data.name: Husniyyah
data.gender_notes: Husniyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'husn', meaning 'goodness' or 'beauty'. In Islamic context, it signifies the inner beauty and excellence of a person. The name is also associated with the concept of 'husn-ud-din', or the beautiful religion of Islam. The name Husniyyah carries the meaning “Goodness, beauty, grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husniyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody goodness, beauty, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husniyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
